items.title: 54271_Charlie Holmes oral history interview
items.q: Smitty and Ford were from Providence.

ctx.x: played piano, who was a great pianist, but... Smitty and Ford were from Providence. And all Smitty could talk about was Hilton Jefferson -- because he was from Providence, too. To Smitty, Hilton Jefferson was the world's greatest saxophonist. Which he was a damn good saxophone player. But see, Jeff was a pretty damn good saxophone player. But all Smitty would talk about was Hilton Jefferson, Hilton Jefferson...

The next time I saw Smitty, which was years later, he was playing saxophone in Erskine Hawkins' band -- Smitty was. And he was a very good saxophone player. I think he's in California now. Because he went to Europe with...
